## Escenarios determinísticos {#sec-mce_results}

{{< include /_chapters/dsha.results.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/GMPE.PSA.ES.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-gmm",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = NULL),
    root = root,
    context = "espectros GMM por escenario"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/Scenarios.ES.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-scenarios",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "parámetros declarados de escenarios"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_fig/UHS.compare.ES.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-compare",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "comparación DSHA"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DSHA.ES.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp, Vs30.target = 760),
    root = root,
    context = "tabla comparativa DSHA"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/Scenarios.PGA.ES.qmd",
    stem = "dsha-scenarios-pga",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "PGA de escenarios por condición"
  )
}
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "i", "SiteTable"
), ls()))
```
